{{Quote|This is Imperial Patrol Frigate ''Guardstar''. Please step down from defensive posture and transmit identification and authorization beams.|The crew of the ''Guardstar'' to the ''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft ''Slave I''|<ref name="DVT" />}}
The '''''Guardstar''''' was an [[Imperial Patrol Frigate]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="DVT" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="FF">{{FactFile|35|FET 15-20|Boba Fett}}</ref> the ''Guardstar'' was [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="DVT" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]].<ref name="CSWE Tatooine">{{CSWECite|III|224|Tatooine}}</ref> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] assisted the Empire in [[Occupation of Bespin|subjugating]] [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]],<ref name="FF" /> a planet in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]].<ref name="CSWE Bespin">{{CSWECite|I|71-72|Bespin}}</ref>

Fett departed Bespin aboard his [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class patrol and attack craft]], [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]. After reaching the Tatoo [[Star system/Legends|system]], the ''Guardstar'' intercepted ''Slave I'' outside Tatooine. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate's]] crew demanded for Fett to step down from his defensive posture and transmit his identification and authorization beams.<ref name="DVT" /> Fett responded with a priority code given to him by [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]],<ref name="FF" /> whose [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] appeared on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] of the ''Guardstar'', saying that ''Slave I'' traveled under Vader's personal protection and would have no Imperial detainment. ''Slave I'' thus landed on Tatooine with no further interruption.<ref name="DVT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Guardstar'' was created for [[1990]]'s "[[Dark Voyage to Tatooine]]," a story published in [[West End Games]]' ''[[Galaxy Guide 5: Return of the Jedi]]'' sourcebook written by [[Michael Stern]].<ref name="DVT" />
